notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-39fac3, 23 September 2026, of the extraction by cc-442dc5 and Codex session a71f92. The published version (Ann. of Math. 193 (2021), 863–978, 116 pages, YMSC mirror, same SHA-256 6f8ac537… as the extraction) was read in full again by four checkers, with the author's preprint and Mihatsch–Zhang (JEMS) consulted. Statements: 53 corrected; locators: 69. Library citations (items 141–148) all exist at the pinned commits. The extraction's repairs are sound (97, 99, 100, 102, 106, 109, 111, 119–122, 125, 126), except 101, whose construction was incomplete and is supplied in its note. 28 new items (3 planned, 25 missing). E1–E28 confirmed; E2 and E9 reclassified to affect nothing, E12 to affect a stated result (Mihatsch–Zhang §7.2 fn. 5 corrects §12's Gaussians), E25 to an error in [47] that affects nothing here; E5's page corrected. 32 new source issues. Most consequential: the proof of Proposition 4.12(i) (and 2.7(i)) needs a norm-one ξ making both det(1 − ξg′) and 1 − ξd units, which exists only for q ≥ n + 1 (FL counterexample at q = n = 3), so the printed proof of the AFL (Theorem 15.1(a)) at p = n has a gap and the FL at q = n (Theorem 13.9(a)) rests on Beuzart-Plessis; Theorem 5.5 is proved only for q ≥ n (Mihatsch proves it in general). Also: Lemmas 4.3(iii)/4.9(iii) need det(1 − g) ≠ 0; Lemma 4.10's 'srs' is false (counterexample); Proposition 7.9(b)'s étaleness is false; (8.11) needs 4π; (9.12) double-counts complex places; Lemma 12.6 omits an archimedean phase; §11.4 and §12.5 use opposite sign conventions; Propositions 2.7(ii)/4.12(ii) are applied outside their printed q-bound (harmless, their proofs do not use it); and several gaps and misprints. All cases with q ≥ n + 1 are unaffected.
